visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, dressed in a black hoodie featuring a stylized white logo, sits centrally in a brightly lit indoor living room. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing expressively with both hands as he speaks. Behind him, a large dark brown leather sofa is visible, adorned with various colorful plush toys and a white air conditioning unit mounted on the plain wall above. The floor in front of him is a polished, warm-toned wood. (2) The man holds up a black padded sleep mask and then proceeds to secure it over his eyes. Holding a smartphone in his right hand, he begins scrolling rapidly with his thumb. A digital screen overlay appears, displaying a shopping interface from the Shopee app, specifically showing a page for 'Guang Ming Deng' (Year-end blessing lamp). A female's hand briefly enters the frame, pointing at the phone screen to assist him. (3) Transition to an unboxing sequence. The man is now wearing a black and white striped turtleneck underneath his hoodie. He sits on the floor surrounded by several delivery packages in gray plastic and cardboard. He rips open a small gray package to reveal a pair of black windproof gloves, which he immediately puts on and displays to the camera with a satisfied expression. He then unboxes a beige garment, which turns out to be a women's sports bra, and hilariously puts it on over his hoodie. (4) He continues unboxing, revealing a large white box containing a pink Kiwicool three-wheel scooter and a black bag containing white sneakers with integrated wheels on the heels. He puts on the sneakers and attempts to ride the tiny scooter across the tiled living room floor. He strikes several comedic poses, leaning back and pointing at the camera while wearing the gloves, sports bra, and roller shoes. Text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen as he speaks directly to the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young male speaker delivers a fast-paced, energetic narration in Mandarin. His voice is clear and professional, with a moderate pitch and high arousal. There is no background music initially, and the room tone is very clean, suggesting a studio-like indoor recording environment with no significant ambient noise. (2) An upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track begins in the background, featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat and synth melodies. The male speaker's intensity increases as he explains the challenge. Intermittent sound effects of a smartphone screen being swiped and a digital 'stop' chime are clearly audible. A female voice is heard briefly laughing. (3) Loud, crinkling sounds of plastic being torn and the percussive thud of cardboard boxes being moved dominate the audio track during the unboxing segment. The male speaker's voice fluctuates in pitch as he expresses surprise and humor at the items he found. The background music remains constant in volume, providing a rhythmic bed. (4) Sounds of small plastic wheels rolling on a hard floor and the percussive impact of the scooter hitting surfaces are heard. The speaker's voice adopts a more rhythmic, persuasive tone as he explains the affiliate program. The BGM maintains a strong beat presence until the final closing line where the audio cuts to silence.
